    A code proving the person can receive at the address they want to sign in with.
    EgradxAccountMessageSender.EmailChanged

    An invitation to join an organization, sent in that organization's name.
    EgradxAccountMessageSender.PasswordChanged
    That the password was changed — so someone who did not do it knows at once.
    EgradxAccountMessageSender.PasswordReset
    A link that sets a new password; to the account's email, with no organization.
    EgradxAccountMessageSender.SignInCode
    A code for signing in, to the account's email.
    EgradxAccountMessageSender.SignInMethodAdded
    A provider (providerName: "Google") now signs in to the account.
    EgradxAccountMessageSender.SignupCode
    A code confirming a sign-up, to the address signing up; there is no account yet.
